question: In the Nutrisigma feeding trial on Garole lambs, which group had the highest mean body weight on day 105, and what was it?
rendered:
Document title: "Impact of Nutrisigma on performance of young Garole lambs"

The group with the highest mean body weight on day 105 was T2, which received 20 g/h/d Nutrisigma. 

To find the mean body weight of T2 on day 105, we can look at Table 4 in the document:

| Variable | C | T1 | T2 | P-value |
| Day 105 | 7.20±0.31^b | 8.34±0.24^a | 8.41±0.27^a | 0.01** |

The mean body weight of T2 on day 105 is 8.41 kg.
